# Partners

## Aldermoor Central

The franchise's central national centre (site `ALD-C`). It takes the
hospital's transfers and examination requests, answers them within a
working day, reports an examination one to three days after it, and asks
the hospital for examinations of its own patients.

## Aldermoor South

The franchise's southern national centre (site `ALD-S`), as Aldermoor
Central.

## Aldermoor abroad

The franchise's three centres abroad (Liège, Aachen, Luxembourg: sites
`ALD-BE`, `ALD-DE`, `ALD-LU`), reached as one.

## The veterinary authority

The national veterinary services. They receive the notifications of
listed diseases, from the hospital's vets and from its laboratory, and
answer each with a reference.
